content.title: Fernandes on course to break Premier League assists record
content.text: Man Utd star is just two away from matching Henry and De Bruyne's incredible feat of 20 assists in one season Bruno Fernandes created another goal in Manchester United's 1-0 win at Chelsea to move him one closer to the all-time record for assists in a single season.The Portuguese set up Matheus Cunha's winner at Stamford Bridge to move him up to 18 assists for the season. Fernandes is on course to break the record for the most Premier League assists in a season, currently standing at 20, which is jointly held by Thierry Henry (2002/03) and Kevin De Bruyne (2019/20).Most PL assists in single season by any player Player Assists Season Thierry Henry (ARS) 20 2002/03 Kevin De Bruyne (MCI) 20 2019/20 Mesut Ozil (ARS) 19 2015/16 Bruno Fernandes (MUN) 18* 2025/26 Cesc Fabregas (CHE) 18 2014/15 Frank Lampard (CHE) 18 2004/05 Kevin De Bruyne (MCI) 18 2016/17 Mohamed Salah (LIV) 18 2024/25 Cesc Fabregas (ARS) 17 2007/08 *After 33 matches, with five remaining Slow start followed by sensational spell The stats certainly suggest that the Portuguese can achieve this feat and produce three more assists for Man Utd in their remaining six matches to set a new record of 21. What makes Fernandes' record-breaking achievement for his club this season so remarkable is that his first assist of the campaign didn't arrive until 19 October, when he set up Harry Maguire for the winning goal in a 2-1 victory at Liverpool. Including that first assist in Matchweek 8 at Anfield, Fernandes has provided 18 from 23 matches, a rate of 0.78 per game. If he were to continue at that rate for the remaining five matches, he would produce at least four more assists, taking his total to 22 this season, two above the record held by Henry and De Bruyne.2025/26 Premier League Playmaker race: Who has the most assists?FeaturesIndeed the fixtures look favourable too, with two of Man Utd's remaining five opponents being teams he has already assisted goals against this season - Liverpool (H) and Nottingham Forest (H). Man Utd's remaining PL fixtures 25/26 Matchweek Opponent 34 BRE (H) 35 LIV (H) 36 SUN (A) 37 NFO (H) 38 BHA (A) Gerrard's set-piece record within reach Another record is within touching distance as Fernandes' assist for Casemiro against Aston Villa on 15 March was his ninth from set-piece situations. Steven Gerrard holds the record for dead-ball assists with 11 in 2013/14. Fernandes, who is tied with Chris Brunt (nine for West Bromwich Albion in 2014/15) in second place for the most set-play assists in a season, can match Gerrard with two more or go past him with another three. He is now on 102 assists in all competitions for Man Utd, and is only the fourth player to reach this milestone for the club, after Ryan Giggs (249), Wayne Rooney (127) and David Beckham (115).
